name: Urban Pro School Backpack — Maroon
description: Xentro Enterprises presents a premium-quality waterproof school backpack designed for students who value comfort, durability and style. Crafted from high-quality polyester with a durable canvas outer finish, this backpack is perfect for school, college, tuition, travel and daily use. Featuring 4 spacious compartments, it offers ample storage for books, notebooks, lunch boxes, stationery, gadgets and other daily essentials. The ergonomic padded shoulder straps provide superior comfort and help reduce shoulder strain, while the adjustable straps ensure a perfect fit for every user.
